site: Mount Gerizim, sacred precinct, building P-II (silver hoard)
context_reported: "hidden in the northwestern wall" of public building P-II (JSP 19 p.[44]); JSP 8 p.[60]: "may have been hidden in one of the walls, and remained intact after the walls' collapse"; Area P, L4749, B47518
source: Magen, Bijovsky & Tzionit 2021, Mount Gerizim Excavations III: The Coins (JSP 19) pp.[44]-[45], [92], [115], Cat. 762-890; Magen 2008 (JSP 8) p.[60]
flags: closing coin Cat. 890 (K 29922) is the sole basis for 120/119; without it the hoard closes 126/125 (side-quest B4b-1). Basket B47518 also held K 29935 = Cat. 233, a bronze catalogued as an isolated coin. Magen asks whether this is the vessel from the Samaritan temple treasury.
terminus_text: latest coin 120/119 BCE (Cat. 890, Akko, Antiochus VIII) per JSP 19 p.[44]; 126/125 if Cat. 890 is intrusive
